label: gradient.py
text:
# signet: in y, out dy
import numpy as np
from signet import signals, Series, Stream
y = signals.y
if isinstance(y, Stream):            # Backward differences
    dy, prev = signals.stream("dy"), None
    for t, v in y:
        if prev is not None:
            dy.write(t, (v - prev[1]) / (t - prev[0]))
        prev = (t, v)
elif isinstance(y, Series):          # Central differences
    x = np.array(y.x)
    dy = np.gradient(np.array(y.values), x)
    signals.dy = signals.series(dy, domain=y.domain, x=x)
else:                                # A vector, unit step
    signals.dy = np.gradient(np.array(y))

text:
# signet: in y, in num::c = 0.0, out running, out num::total
import numpy as np # NumPy 2 for np.trapezoid (np.trapz in NumPy 1.x).
from signet import signals, Series, Stream
y, c = signals.y, signals.c
if isinstance(y, Stream):            # One trapezoid per sample
 running, prev, total = signals.stream("running"), None, c
 for t, v in y:
 if prev is not None:
 total += (t - prev[0]) * (v + prev[1]) / 2
 running.write(t, total + 0 * v)  # Same kind as y
 prev = (t, v)
elif isinstance(y, Series):          # Running trapezoids
 x, v = np.array(y.x), np.array(y.values)
 steps = np.diff(x) * (v[1:] + v[:-1]) / 2
 running = c + np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(steps)))
 signals.running = signals.series(running, domain=y.domain, x=x)
 total = c + np.trapezoid(v, x)
else:                                # A vector, unit step
 v = np.array(y)
 steps = (v[1:] + v[:-1]) / 2
 running = c + np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(steps)))
 signals.running, total = running, c + np.trapezoid(v)
signals.total = total

# signet: in float::v, in float::force, in float::grade
# signet: in float::dt, in float::mu
# signet: in float::wd_front = 0.6, out float::speed
from signet import signals
M, G, RHO, CDA, CRR = 1500.0, 9.80665, 1.2, 0.6, 0.010
v, mu, wd = signals.v, signals.mu, signals.wd_front
max_tract_force_acc = mu * M * G * wd         # Front axle
max_tract_force_brake = -mu * M * G           # All wheels
f = max(signals.force, max_tract_force_brake)
f = min(f, max_tract_force_acc)
drag = 0.5 * RHO * CDA * v * v                # Air, N
roll = CRR * M * G                            # Tires, N
hill = M * G * signals.grade                  # Grade, N
signals.speed = v + signals.dt * (f - drag - roll - hill) / M

# signet: in float::voltage_in, out float::voltage_meas
using Signet: signals, series
v = signals.voltage_in
VOLTAGE_DROP = 0.63   # voltage drop property
DIODE = "GOOD"   # or "SHORTED", "OPEN", "REVERSED"
if DIODE == "GOOD"
    vF = VOLTAGE_DROP
    vR = v
elseif DIODE == "SHORTED"
    vF = 0.0     # shorted to ground, no voltage measured across it
    vR = 0.0
elseif DIODE == "OPEN"
    vF = v       # open circuit, voltage at the measuring nodes only
    vR = v
elseif DIODE == "REVERSED"
    vF = v       # installed backwards, conducts on the negative supply
    vR = -VOLTAGE_DROP
end
vm = v > 0 ? vF : v < 0 ? vR : 0.0     # forward, reverse, or no supply
write(signals, "voltage_meas", vm, "float")
println("diode: $DIODE, voltage_in $v V, voltage_meas $vm V")

program speedcheck
  use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding
  implicit none
  interface                                          
    real(c_double) function strtod(p, e) bind(c)
      import :: c_ptr, c_double
      type(c_ptr), value :: p
      type(c_ptr) :: e
    end function
  end interface
  character(len=:), allocatable, target :: s
  real(c_double), allocatable :: x(:)
  type(c_ptr) :: e
  integer(c_intptr_t) :: p
  integer :: u, sz, a, b, i
  open(newunit=u, file="generator.x.sig", access="stream", form="unformatted", action="read")
  inquire(unit=u, size=sz)
  allocate(character(len=sz + 1) :: s)
  read(u) s(1:sz)                                    
  close(u)
  s(sz + 1:) = c_null_char                           
  a = index(s, '"value": [') + len('"value": [')     
  b = a + index(s(a:), ']') - 2
  allocate(x(count([(s(i:i) == ',', i = a, b)]) + 1))
  p = transfer(c_loc(s(a:a)), p)
  do i = 1, size(x)                                  
    x(i) = strtod(transfer(p, e), e)
    p = transfer(e, p) + 1
  end do
  print '(g0.16)', sqrt(sum((x - sum(x) / size(x))**2) / (size(x) - 1))   
end program speedcheck

# sweep.jl: LOGARITHMIC SINE SWEEP     
#
# Writes a logarithmic sine sweep to the "waveform" output port (<prefix>-sweep.waveform.sig).
# Defaults: NASA GEVS protoflight low-level sine survey, 0.25 g, 20-2000 Hz at 4 octaves/minute.
# Arguments or Starfire parameters (all optional): f0 Hz, f1 Hz, octaves (per minute), rate (samples/s), amplitude (g)
# --stream (or a stream parameter) writes it as a stream at 5000 samples/s by default, in real time if possible
using Signet: signals, series, stream
# signet: out waveform
function arg(name, default)
    i = findfirst(==("--$name"), ARGS)
    v = i === nothing ? get(ENV, "STARFIRE_PARAM_$(uppercase(name))", "") : ARGS[i + 1]
    isempty(v) ? default : parse(Float64, v)
end
streaming = "--stream" in ARGS || !isempty(get(ENV, "STARFIRE_PARAM_STREAM", ""))
f0, f1, oct, amp = arg("f0", 20.0), arg("f1", 2000.0), arg("octaves", 4.0), arg("amplitude", 0.25)
rate = arg("rate", streaming ? 5000.0 : 10000.0)
r = oct / 60                                          # Octaves/s
dur = log2(f1 / f0) / r
dt = 1 / rate
n = floor(Int, dur * rate)
x(t) = amp * sin(2π * f0 * (2^(r * t) - 1) / (r * log(2)))
ts = (0:n-1) .* dt
if streaming
    s, t0 = stream("waveform"; domain="time"), time()
    for t in ts
        sleep(max(0, t0 + t - time()))  # Real time, or flat out
        write(s, t, x(t))
    end
else
    signals.waveform = series(x.(ts); domain="time", start=0.0, step=dt)
end
println("sweep: $f0-$f1 Hz at $oct oct/min, $(round(dur, digits=1)) s, $n samples at $rate Hz, $amp g peak")

# stft.jl: SHORT-TIME FOURIER TRANSFORM
#
# Reads a time series or a time stream on "signal_in"; writes the dominant frequency in each window
# ("ridge", time) and the mean magnitude spectrum ("spectrum", series::frequency). From a series, the ridge is
# a series; from a stream, it is a stream, one value per window as each fills, and the spectrum is written
# when the stream ends.
# Arguments or Starfire parameters (optional): window, hop (samples). Defaults suit the GEVS sweep from sweep.jl:
# 1024-sample windows every 512 samples, 9.8 Hz bins at 10000 samples/s.
using Signet: signals, series, stream, StreamIn
# signet: in signal_in, out spectrum, out ridge
function arg(name, default)
    k = findfirst(==("--$name"), ARGS)
    v = i === nothing ? get(ENV, "STARFIRE_PARAM_$(uppercase(name))", "") : ARGS[i + 1]
    isempty(v) ? default : parse(Int, v)
end
fail(msg) = (println(stderr, "stft: ", msg); exit(1))
win, hop = arg("window", 1024), arg("hop", 512)
nb = win ÷ 2 + 1
w = [0.5 - 0.5 * cos(2π * m / (win - 1)) for m in 0:win-1]    # Hann
E = [cis(-2π * p * m / win) for p in 0:nb-1, m in 0:win-1]    # DFT rows, bins 0..win/2
frame(seg) = abs.(E * (seg .* w))
function from_series(s)
    s.domain == "time" || fail("signal_in must be a time series, got $(s.domain)")
    x = Float64.(s.values)
    dt = s.step === nothing ? s.x[2] - s.x[1] : s.step
    length(x) >= win || fail("$(length(x)) samples is shorter than the $win-sample window")
    starts = 0:hop:length(x)-win
    mag = permutedims(reduce(hcat, [frame(x[k+1:k+win]) for k in starts]))   # frames x bins
    f = collect(0:nb-1) ./ (win * dt)
    t = [(k + win / 2) * dt for k in starts]                             	# Window centers
    ridge = [f[argmax(mag[r, :])] for r in axes(mag, 1)]
    signals.ridge = series(ridge; domain="time", x=t)
    signals.spectrum = series(vec(sum(mag, dims=1)) ./ size(mag, 1); domain="frequency", x=f)
    println("stft: $(length(t)) windows of $win (hop $hop), $(f[2]) Hz bins, ridge $(ridge[1]) -> $(ridge[end]) Hz")
end
function from_stream(s)
    ridge = stream("ridge"; domain="time")
    buf, total, frames = Float64[], zeros(nb), 0
    t0, dt, f, first_r, last_r = NaN, NaN, Float64[], NaN, NaN
    for (t, v) in s    # Each sample as it arrives, until the stream ends
        if isnan(t0)
            t0 = t
        elseif isnan(dt)
            dt = t - t0
            dt > 0 || fail("signal_in's samples must rise in time")
            f = collect(0:nb-1) ./ (win * dt)
        end
        push!(buf, v)
        if length(buf) >= win
            m = frame(buf[1:win])
            total .+= m
            last_r = f[argmax(m)]
            frames == 0 && (first_r = last_r)
            write(ridge, t0 + (frames * hop + win / 2) * dt, last_r)     	      # Window center
            frames += 1
            deleteat!(buf, 1:hop)
        end
    end
    frames > 0 || fail("the stream ended before filling the $win-sample window")
    signals.spectrum = series(total ./ frames; domain="frequency", x=f)
    println("stft: $frames windows of $win (hop $hop) from a stream, $(f[2]) Hz bins, ridge $first_r -> $last_r Hz")
end

import json, sys
print("digraph signet {\n  rankdir=LR; node [shape=box];")
for c in json.load(sys.stdin):
    dst = c["module"]
    for ref in c["refs"]:
        src, port = ref.split(".")[:2]
        dash = ", style=dashed" if ref in c["stepped"] else ""
        print(f'  "{src}" -> "{dst}" [label="{port} → {c["port"]}"{dash}];')
    for k in c["constants"]:
        node = f'{dst}.{c["port"]}={k}'  # One node per use
        print(f'  "{node}" [label="{k}", shape=plaintext];')
        print(f'  "{node}" -> "{dst}" [label="{c["port"]}"];')
